sources.title: Kay et al 2022 eLife pupillary test
Wicken et al 2021 fear imagery study

claims.text: Aphantasia describes markedly diminished voluntary visual imagery
claims.restriction: No diagnostic claims

claims.text: Not all individuals have same imagery or modality profile
claims.restriction: Variability; avoid universal conclusions

claims.text: 2022 study compared control participants and 18 with aphantasia on imagery pupil responses
claims.restriction: Specific experimental conditions, no home test

claims.text: Aphantasia eliminates all mental cognition or creativity
claims.restriction: False generalization

claims.text: Imagery differences make guided meditation ineffective for all people with aphantasia
claims.restriction: No population-specific clinical outcomes established

claims.text: A reading/imagery fear-task study showed differentiated skin conductance
claims.restriction: Not a mental-health protection claim

claims.text: Inspire3 lists Zen12 among its programs
claims.restriction: Does not verify affiliate approval

claims.text: Main Zen12 Premium page describes 48 MP3s and 12 levels
claims.restriction: Verify before publication; catalog description

claims.text: Main Premium offer visually displays $87.99
claims.restriction: May change or vary by checkout, do not advertise

claims.text: Conditional Zen12 campaign displays $37 with a countdown
claims.restriction: Do not inherit urgency, scarcity or promotional conditions

claims.restriction: Buyer must inspect current written terms; not tested

claims.text: Public affiliate signup portal represents acceptance of FV
claims.restriction: Signed named account authorization required

claims.text: Affiliate program public payout amounts apply to FV
claims.restriction: No negotiated commission terms, do not quote

claims.text: Affiliate disclosures should be clear and close to commercial recommendations
claims.restriction: Do not rely on footers alone

claims.text: Specific Zen12 mental-health, wealth and brainwave effects are independently proven
claims.restriction: No product-specific trials independently validated here

claims.text: Brief audio mindfulness studies show small-study limited outcomes
